sentences.text:
Jay Singha Banerjee And Others vs The State Of West Bengal
And Another on 18 August, 2023
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 D/L16 C.R.R.1429 of 2022
18.08.2023
Bpg.
In Re: An application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure;
Jay Singha Banerjee and others Versus The State of West Bengal and another Mr. Subrata
Bhattacharjee.
...for the petitioners.
Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherjee, Ld.P.P. Mr. Imran Ali Ms. Debjani Sahu.
An accommodation has been sought for on behalf of the learned advocate engaged for conducting the revisional application.
Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon Mr. Imran Ali, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State.
His appearance may be regularised by the concerned authorities.

Petitioners approached this Court challenging the continuance of Mogra Police Station Case No.14 of 2021 dated 11.01.2021 wherein charge-sheet was submitted under Sections 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code.

The enclosures to the revisional application include only First Information Report and documents relating to passport of the petitioner and the charge-sheet which has been submitted before the jurisdictional court.

None of the documents under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure which gives rise to the formation of the opinion under Section 173 of the Code of Criminal Procedure have been enclosed along with the present revisional application.

Petitioners, as such, are directed to canvass the issues in the present revisional application by way of taking out an application in the nature of Section 239 of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the jurisdictional Magistrate after receipt of the copies under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

If such application is filed, the learned jurisdictional Magistrate would dispose of the application for discharge in accordance with law without being influenced by any observations made Jay Singha Banerjee And Others vs The State Of West Bengal And Another on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115467518/
1 by this Court.
